notes: The prompt leads with a driving game full of cars, jeeps and motorcycles to explore a map in, with no lap and no finish, so it is Simulation on Vehicle Sim rather than Racing. The crash reactions are the other half of what was asked for, so I added physics-rig from Physics Sim, since taking a second preset's option is free once its shape does not come with it, and I dropped Vehicle Sim's resource-shared because nothing is mined or hauled. The scale answer settles the prompt's own 'make the map big' as a few city blocks, so this stays one contiguous world-open surface built in a single pass rather than separate zones, and settlement-density carries those blocks. Decided without a user: low graphics and textured buildings are art direction rather than layout, the answer confirmed players never apply their own textures so there is no build plot, and with no interiors requested the poles, lights and walls you crash into are all exterior street furniture, keeping this on P0.
